0022600166.text: The Timberwolves (4-3, 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, 14th in the East) in Minnesota's eighth game of the season, coming off a loss and carrying a 2-1 home record. Anthony Edwards (33.3 points per game this season) is out after knee surgery and Donte DiVincenzo is out after Achilles surgery, while LaMelo Ball (wrist) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, most recently beating Milwaukee 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
